Rooftop mixed nuts.d: Cashews, almonds, peanuts and pumpkin seeds glazed with sesame, oven crisp, served cool in a paper cup.

Edamame.d: Young green soybeans boiled in the pod, sea salt and a few drops of sesame oil.
Edamame.note: We bring a bowl for the pods.

Teriyaki rice bowl.d: Boneless thigh seared crisp on the skin side, glazed with soy, mirin, sake and sugar, sliced over steamed short grain rice with pink pickled ginger and scallion.
Teriyaki rice bowl.note: Chef's special. Our number one seller.

Coconut ice cream.d: Churned in our kitchen, rich and smooth, with golden flakes stirred through and more on top.

Rooftop iced matcha honey lemonade.d: Fresh squeezed, sweetened with honey, poured over ice, with a frothy shot of whisked Japanese matcha floated on top. Sprig of mint.
Rooftop iced matcha honey lemonade.note: Made to order. Stir before drinking.
